candidates.change_summary: Replace the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with withdrawing a fixed amount 0, causing no funds to be transferred by withdrawAll.
Replace the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with withdrawing only half of the contract balance, changing resulting balance after withdrawAll.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier invocation from withdrawAll so anyone can call it, changing who can trigger the withdrawal and thus observable behavior.
Change the onlyOwner check to require msg.sender != owner, inverting the ownership check so withdrawAll can only be called by non-owners.
Make withdrawAll perform no action (empty body), leaving contract balance unchanged after call.
Replace transfer with call to send value and forward gas, changing revert/return behavior and thus observable withdraw outcome.
Change onlyOwner modifier to allow anyone (remove require), altering who can call withdraw and thus observed withdraw behavior.
Replace low-level call with a transfer to make sendMoney revert on gas stipend/external throw, changing whether balances are forwarded and thus altering observable balance after call.
Replace call with a call that checks the return value and reverts on failure, making sendMoney revert when the target rejects funds rather than silently continuing.

Remove the owner restriction by replacing onlyOwner modifier body to do nothing (always allow), so sendMoney can be called by non-owners and thus change observable balances after calls by different callers.
